description: Anouk Dierickx publishes R scripts for estimating precipitation return levels from EURO-SUPREME annual maxima. Zenodo archives version 1.0 from October 2025, free under CC BY 4.0. The input collection derives from the CMIP5-generation EURO-CORDEX 0.11-degree ensemble. Scripts prepare spatial masks, estimate return levels, add elevation and summarise biases for Belgium, the United Kingdom, Germany, Finland, Denmark and the Netherlands; a separate script operates over the full domain. This can supply rainfall assumptions for flood-defence and drainage simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this workflow. Coverage and climate periods depend on the selected input release. The published paper identifies an updated WDCC dataset, while the archived README references the earlier DOI. That version distinction is a limitation requiring attention before reproducing figures. Climate-model return levels are not local observed design standards. No input files were downloaded, statistical fits reproduced or station-scale suitability checked.
